description: Who may decide architecture decisions through the Architecture Studio, and which roles each decision needs. A GitHub account is recognised only if BOTH its login and its numeric id match, so a renamed or recycled login gets nothing. People are empty by default so that every decision action is denied until the owner registers an approver (comments are still allowed). On 2026-10-30 the owner instructed in chat that the GitHub account polyfuze4336-bot be registered as programme owner; that instruction is not a signed approval. Adding or removing a person is a control-plane change made by a human in a reviewed pull request. It is not a signed approval under ADR 0008 and does not enrol a signing key in harness/policy/approvers.json. A bot, organisation or agent account must never be listed.
